brand.name: FoxESS
brand.notes: Chinese-origin solar hybrid inverter maker that runs per-country manual portals; pk.fox-ess.com hosts the manuals that apply to Pakistani installs, confirming active PK distribution.

H3/AC3 (three-phase hybrid) - power stage, bus and relay faults
KH/KA (single-phase hybrid) - parallel-system relay and sampling-consistency faults
KH/KA (single-phase hybrid) - battery pack mismatch and pack hardware faults
